messages:
maria.g: Heads up — scheduling a short maintenance for APAC dedicated clusters tonight. Need a public statuspage update + localized email blurb for JP and AU. Affects: dedicated inference (text gen/chat) in ap-northeast-1. Window: 2026-09-15 01:00–01:30 UTC (10:00–10:30 JST). Expected user impact: brief 5–10m errors during node reboot, otherwise health remains. Will not change model pins unless rollback required.

deploybot: Scheduled maintenance job created: id=jb-78223. Target window start 2026-09-15T01:00:00Z. Canary strategy: 25% for 10m then 100%. Noted: kernel patch + runtime restart.

sam.k: Ack — I'll be oncall for the window. Prefer to avoid any model pin changes; can we confirm no quantization/weights swap?

ops_jen: Confirmed: kernel patch only. No model pinning. Rollback plan: revert kernel package, restart runtime pool, reprovision NVCache, then run smoke tests: `./scripts/smoke-apac.sh`. Estimated rollback time 12–18m.

support_lead: Draft public blurb (English):

```
We will perform a brief maintenance of our APAC dedicated inference clusters on 2026-09-15 01:00 UTC. During the window some requests may return errors or experience increased latency for up to 10 minutes. We expect full recovery within 30 minutes.
```

Can we add a JP localized line and an AU wording? Also suggest adding a link to status page detail.

maria.g: JP draft: "2026-09-15 01:00 UTC に APAC 専用クラスターのメンテナンスを実施します。ウィンドウ中、一時的にリクエストがエラーになるか遅延が発生する可能性があります。通常30分以内に復旧します。詳細はステータスページをご確認ください。"

statusbot: Statuspage update queued for 01:00 UTC. Preview payload:

```json
{
  "component": "APAC Dedicated Inference",
  "status": "maintenance",
  "scheduled_for": "2026-09-15T01:00:00Z",
  "expected_duration_minutes": "30",
  "public_message": "Brief maintenance for APAC dedicated inference. Short errors/latency possible; expected recovery within 30 minutes. See localized notices for JP/AU."
}
```

support_lead: LGTM. Add a short email subject: "Planned maintenance — APAC dedicated inference (2026-09-15)". Please queue the statuspage update 30m prior and send the localized email 1 hour before window start. :white_check_mark:

sam.k: Canary will be 25% for 10m then full rollout if no regressions. I'll watch model quality dashboards and rollback if any token-level regressions >1.5% slip.

maria.g: Thanks — I'll post statuspage + send localized emails per schedule and paste the final statuspage link here once it's live.
